section: Kits: JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, and Markdown
finding: | `kits/language/css/manifest.toml:82-92` `module-classes`, `src/checks/language/css.ts:94-131` | The check reports false findings. Classes inside `:global(...)` count as module classes, so they are reported as unused (verified: `walkClasses` returns `dark` for `.root :global(.dark)`). Dynamic access (`styles[variant]`) and destructuring record no reads, so every class of that sheet is reported as unused. Every finding points at line 1. | These bugs support the replacement by eslint-plugin-css-modules that FINDINGS proposes in the built-in checks section. Until then, skip `:global` classes, skip unused-class findings for sheets read dynamically, and report the line of each class. |

finding: | `kits/language/markdown/manifest.toml:80` `fences` `summary`, `src/config/checks/language/markdown.ts:8-29`, `src/checks/language/markdown.ts:105` | "Every fenced code block with a language tag" is not true.
